app.slogan: Lie like a champion. Vote like a detective.

store.section.frames.desc: Deck out your share cards with killer neon frames.
mascot.description: A friendly character shaped like a retro handheld gaming console with a chunky blue body, bright yellow accent stripes on the buttons and edges, and a small antenna nub on top. The entire silhouette has a thick black outline. Its face is a large glowing screen with two simple black dot eyes and a wide expressive mouth. On wins it jumps upward with a huge toothy grin and sparkle effects around its eyes. On losses it wobbles side to side with spiral dizzy-eyes and a wavy frown. Flat vector art style, bold saturated colors, kawaii-meets-arcade aesthetic, white background.

about.creatorBio: Built solo by Muhammed Awesat, who just wanted a fun way to catch friends lying badly. Every pixel, every line of code, and every ridiculous fake answer came from the same place — wanting game night to hit different.
about.creditsBody: Made with React, Socket.io, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and way too much coffee. Thanks for playing — now go deceive your friends responsibly.
